definitions: A person or thing that reduces something.
A chemical substance used to remove oxygen from another substance, especially in photography.
A device that reduces the speed or increases the torque of a rotating shaft.
A fitting used to connect pipes or ducts of different sizes.
examples: The company hired a cost reducer to optimize expenses.
The photographer used a reducer to lighten the overexposed print.
The gearbox acts as a speed reducer for the motor.
He needed a reducer to connect the large main pipe to the smaller branch.
